transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's get started with the final signoff meeting. We have the finale coming up this Saturday at 8:00 PM, with two finalists performing before the winner is announced. The current draft package includes web-and-QR voting, 'Northern Lights' as the closing performance, an immediate winner reveal, and optional closed captions. Before I approve the binding finale package, I need each of you — audience, music, broadcast, and accessibility leads — to report any confirmed production requirements on your end. Who would like to go first?
